protocol.description: Strict zero-even-leakage Odd->Even retrospective archive evaluation using frozen Paper 2 weights (v2_refine.pth, 19,393 params).
protocol.odd_even_phasing: Split complex Yc before phasing; ph_o from Yc_o[-1], ph_e from Yc_e[-1]; Yo_s = Re(Yc_o * exp(-i*ph_o)), Ye_on_o_phase = Re(Yc_e * exp(-i*ph_o)), Ye_s = Re(Yc_e * exp(-i*ph_e)).
protocol.strict_nrmse_formula: Normalize Yo_s and Ye_on_o_phase by scale_o = max|Yo_s|; fit alpha_o >= 0 solely on Yo_s; evaluate RMSE(alpha_o * K1 @ M_odd @ K2_even^T * DL1*DL2 - Ye_n).
